verdict.rationale: Omnara is a managed-agent platform. Automated PR review is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence pack never documents automatic pull-request review or AI-generated inline comments. Generic building blocks such as YAML agent configs, MCP servers, skills and event webhooks could be used to construct a reviewer, but they are not the capability itself and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have every pull request automatically reviewed with AI-generated inline comments
